chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr.

key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: al-Ḥimyarī; a nisbah identifying one of the transmitters
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; part of the author’s chain of transmission
key_terms.عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ: from ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr; the point to which this transmission chain leads
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; an explicit transmission formula

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for the reports transmitted from ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr in the book. It documents the author’s route of transmission through his father and named transmitters back to ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr, serving as a hadith-sciences reference rather than a doctrinal or legal teaching.
